title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1972-12-11
lineage: 2nd generation reels (Revox A77) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2021 > TLH flac2496
source: Master 7" Soundboard Reels @ 7 1/2 ips > Reel to Reel @ 3 3/4 ips (Kidd dub for Jerry) > Reel to Reel @ 3 3/4 ips(Will Boswell)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard mix with a stellar set list that even a healthier Pigpen couldn't improve
ai_review.review: The reviewer gives the recording a perfect five‑star rating for both the mix and the performance, praising the meticulous mixing work and the overall set list. While noting that more Pigpen material would have been nice, the enthusiasm is unmistakable and the soundboard source is described as crystal clear.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review, but it rates both the show and recording at five stars, indicating an exceptional performance and excellent sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix praised as crystal‑clear, well‑balanced, with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set list highly praised; reviewer wishes Pigpen had a few more tunes but overall considers the performance top‑notch.
